prediction_text: Direction: Labour wins in a landslide. Keir Starmer's Labour defeats Rishi Sunak's Conservatives on 4 July 2024 by a very large margin — Labour takes a commanding Commons majority (400+ seats) and the Conservatives fall to their worst result in modern history (around or below 130 seats). Sunak's D-Day early departure is read as the campaign's symbolic self-inflicted wound.
